Summary of the implementation:

**Files in `output/`:**
- `main.js` (532 lines) — CLI entry point, argument parsing, file I/O orchestration
- `lex.js` (451 lines) — Lexer/parser for G-code lines with full RS274/NGC expression support
- `state.js` (260 lines) — Machine state model, modal groups, defaults
- `exec.js` (1725 lines) — Block executor: motion handling, canned cycles, CRC, probing
- `trace.js` (570 lines) — Trace generation with all 3 stepping modes and delta computation
- `io.js` (148 lines) — Tool table and parameter file I/O

**What it supports:**
- All RS274/NGC G codes (G0–G3, G4, G10, G17–G19, G20/21, G28, G30, G38.2, G40–G42, G43/49, G53, G54–G59.3, G61/61.1/64, G80–G89, G90/91, G92/.1/.2/.3, G93/94, G98/99)
- All M codes (M0/1/2/30/60, M3/4/5, M6, M7/8/9, M48/49)
- Full expression evaluation with parameters, unary/binary operations
- Modal G/M group tracking with proper defaults
- Cutter radius compensation (basic — handles D0, perpendicular offsets, entry move)
- Tool length offsets with H number lookup
- Coordinate system offsets with G92 active/inactive states
- All trace stepping modes: --trace-time-step, --trace-distance-step, --trace-position-tolerance
- Trace deltas (only differences from prior entry)
- motion_kind labels for canned cycle sub-motions
- nonmodal_g_codes labels properly attached to first emitted entry of each sub-motion
- Trailing entries for post-motion state changes (e.g., G84 spindle restore)
- M2/M30 program-end reset
- Probe motion with --probe-box geometry
- Block delete switch handling
- Percent delimiters
- Parameter file read/write
- Tool table reading

Exit codes: 0 success, 1 spec-defined program error (invalid input), 2 internal simulator error.
